messages:
leila: Quick update: shadow runs for model v2p2-int4 completed. Headline: ~10% token cost down, ~55% throughput up on p4-small, but long-doc MRR regressed: baseline 78.4 -> v2p2 76.6 (-1.8 abs). Legal slice hallucination +0.7% abs. p99 tail +2ms. Block or proceed? :thinking_face:
omar: can you paste slice breakdown? which cohorts drive the delta?
leila: short breakdown:
- general: MRR -0.3 abs
- long-docs (>8k tokens): MRR -1.8 abs (N=4200, 95% CI delta [-2.4, -1.2])
- code-snips: MRR +0.1 abs
- legal: hallucination +0.7 abs (p=0.02)
nina: p=0.02 on legal is concerning. Do we have exact sample counts per legal subset?
leila: legal N=1200 across contracts/briefs. CI on hallucination +0.3..+1.1.
shawn: given the CI and sample sizes, my recommendation: prevent automated promote >5% traffic until we either fix quant kernel or run a targeted long-doc warmup burn-in.
omar: I suspect KV-cache warmup interaction with int4 - prefix coherency hits long contexts. Can we run a warmed-KV shadow?
leila: kicking off warm-kv shadow now (1h) and a 5k-sample synthetic long-doc fuzz to probe prefix sensitivity.
eval-bot: eval job created: id=ev-175432-01. Tracking: MRR, hallucination_rate, exact_match, latency_p95/p99. URL: https://internal/evals/ev-175432-01
shawn: draft canary config suggestion:
```yaml
canary:
  phases: [0.01, 0.05, 0.2]  # 1% -> 5% -> 20%~ over 3h
  min_samples_per_phase: 2000
  metrics:
    mrr: {relative_threshold_pct: -1.0, absolute_threshold: -0.5, direction: decrease}
    hallucination_rate: {absolute_threshold: +0.3, direction: increase}
  significance: {alpha: 0.05, method: bootstrap}
  auto_fallback:
    enabled: true
    trigger: any_metric_exceeds_threshold
    min_consecutive_windows: 2
    cooldown: 30m
```
nina: two asks: 1) use both rel+abs thresholds for MRR (long-docs often show small abs numbers but meaningful rel drops). 2) require at least one metric with >2000 samples AND p<0.05 before auto-fallback, to avoid noisy triggers.
omar: also add a soft-degrade route: if hallucination breaches but MRR holds, divert 50% of canary traffic to v2p2 with extra rerank rather than immediate rollback. Cheaper stopgap.
sre-bot: routing note added to draft config:
```nroute: {name: "v2p2-soft-degrade", weight: 0.5, modifiers: [rerank_high_confidence]}
```
leila: action list: 1) finish warm-kv shadow (me), 2) run long-doc burn-in (me), 3) implement canary config with N=2k min samples + CI (shawn), 4) prepare soft-degrade route (omar). Waiting for ev-175432-01 results before any dedicated canary promotion.
shawn: TL;DR: block automated promote until long-doc CI narrows or delta <0.5 abs. Manual tiny canary OK with rerank soft-degrade. :thumbsup:
leila: thanks all 44c will post eval summary when ev-175432-01 finishes. :white_check_mark:
